about: Hand-kept list of dated events for the 2-week Catalyst Calendar. Times in UTC (8:30 AM ET = 13:30 UTC, 2:00 PM ET = 19:00 UTC in winter). allday = no set time. end = last day of a multi-day event. est = date expected, not yet confirmed. cat: econ, fed, earnings, politics, world, markets, fyi. keys = words that link an event to prediction markets (empty = no market link). Sources: BLS, BEA, Census, federalreserve.gov, company IR pages, UNFCCC, APEC, OPEC, state election offices. Add new events monthly.

events.name: Congress returns for the lame-duck session
events.note: First week back after the midterms. Top job: funding the government before the Dec 11 deadline.

events.name: COP31 climate summit, Antalya
events.note: UN climate talks in Turkey, Nov 9-20. World leaders attend Nov 11-12.

events.name: CPI inflation report (Oct)
events.note: The headline inflation number. A surprise either way moves Fed and inflation markets.

events.name: Veterans Day: bond market closed
events.note: Stocks trade, but the bond market and banks are closed. Expect thinner trading.

events.name: Producer prices, PPI (Oct)
events.note: Wholesale inflation, three days after CPI. Feeds the Fed's preferred measure.

events.name: Home Depot earnings
events.note: Before the open. A read on housing and the US consumer.

events.name: Retail sales (Oct)
events.note: How much Americans spent last month. Big for recession and consumer markets.

events.name: Nvidia earnings
events.note: After the close (results ~4:20 PM ET, call 5 PM). The AI trade's biggest event of the quarter.

events.name: Leonid meteor shower peaks
events.note: Night of Nov 17-18. Nothing to trade, but a nice break from the screens.

events.name: APEC leaders' summit, Shenzhen
events.note: Pacific leaders meet in China, Nov 18-19. Watch for US-China trade and tariff headlines.

events.name: Fed minutes (Oct meeting)
events.note: Notes from the last Fed meeting. Hints about the December rate decision.

events.name: Walmart earnings
events.note: Expected date, not yet confirmed. The biggest read on the US shopper before the holidays.

events.name: Consumer sentiment, final (Nov)
events.note: How confident households feel. It has been near record lows all year.

events.name: Monthly options expiration
events.note: Third Friday. Stock moves can get jumpy into the close.

events.name: Full Beaver supermoon
events.note: Last full moon before Thanksgiving. Trading folklore says full moons bring volatility; no proof, but people talk about it.

events.name: GDP (Q3, 2nd estimate) + PCE inflation (Oct)
events.note: Growth plus the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, on one morning. Last big data before December's Fed meeting.

events.name: Fed Beige Book
events.note: Fed's district-by-district survey of the economy.

events.name: Thanksgiving: US markets closed
events.note: Holiday week means thin trading. Prices can jump on small orders, on every site.

events.name: Black Friday: stocks close at 1 PM ET
events.note: Shortened session. Holiday-sales numbers start to come in over the weekend.

events.name: OPEC+ monthly meeting
events.note: Saudi Arabia, Russia and five others decide January oil output. Moves oil and gas-price markets.

events.name: Georgia runoff (if needed)
events.note: Any Georgia race where nobody passed 50% on Nov 3 is decided today.

events.name: Jobs report (Nov)
events.note: Payrolls and unemployment rate. The biggest monthly data release.

events.name: Fed rate decision
events.note: Rate decision plus new projections and a press conference.

events.name: CPI inflation report (Nov)
events.note: Inflation, the morning after the Fed decision.

events.name: Government funding deadline
events.note: Current funding runs out. Without a new bill, a shutdown starts Dec 12.

events.name: Louisiana general runoff
events.note: Louisiana's December runoff for races with no majority on Nov 3.

events.name: Producer prices, PPI (Nov)
events.note: Wholesale inflation.

events.name: Retail sales (Nov)
events.note: First read on holiday-season spending.

events.name: Quad witching
events.note: Quarterly options and futures all expire at once. Often the busiest, jumpiest day of the quarter.

events.name: PCE inflation (Nov) + GDP (Q3, final)
events.note: Fed's preferred inflation gauge, right before Christmas.

events.name: New Congress sworn in
events.note: The 120th Congress, elected Nov 3, takes over.

events.name: Fed rate decision
events.note: First Fed decision of 2027.
